# PX evaluation harness · systems reproduction

[Home](../../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../README.md) · [All experiments](../README.md)

The full-task comparison uses ABot-M0 × Qwen3-VL-2B, two GPUs, all 50 Randomized tasks and ten episodes per task. The harness serves one model per GPU with simulation workers and shared episode queues. W denotes workers per GPU; batch cap is one.

| Entry | Successes / episodes | Startup-inclusive seconds | Allocated GPU-hours | Episodes/min |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Original PX / W6 | 411/500 | 4185.99 | 2.326 | 7.17 |
| Harness / W6 | 408/500 | 2222.52 | 1.235 | 13.50 |
| Harness / W16 | 401/500 | 1814.54 | 1.008 | 16.53 |

W6 increases observed episode throughput 1.88× over the original entry; W16 reaches 2.31×. Seed acceptance, instruction sampling and realized steps differ: W6/W16 use 32/24 replacement-seed episodes. These are systems observations, not matched capability gains or isolated neural-network latency measurements.

## Matched-input topology and batch comparison

| Topology | Batch cap | Successes / episodes | Rollout seconds | Startup-inclusive seconds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| centralized | 1 | 101/120 | 405.435 | 485.22 |
| centralized | 4 | 95/120 | 472.496 | 529.27 |
| replicated_colocated | 1 | 99/120 | 414.647 | 471.01 |

These three 12-task runs share task/seed/instruction inputs, but realized action counts differ. Increasing the batch cap from one to four did not improve this workload. Separate issue-bearing four-GPU runs and a failed ABot Qwen3.5-2B harness launch are excluded from capability conclusions; the latter does not invalidate the completed historical 100-episode-per-task 2B evaluation.
